## Plan → landed

| planned | landed |
|---|---|
| deterministic bipartite layout | `figures/layout.py` — closed-form two-column placement; anchors left / counterparties right; narrow stacks columns |
| deterministic radial ego | `figures/layout.py` — entity centred, neighbours on a circle in relation sectors; `(group ordinal, label, id)` ordering throughout |
| BSD/OSI-compatible overview-layout wrapper | **in-repo implementation, zero dependency** — satisfies K2 §6.3's licence pin strictly; `igraph` never imported (asserted); recorded in ADR-226 §1 |
| graph input/output model | `figures/graph_model.py` — `sig.figure-kit-graph/1`, `sig.figure-kit-chart/1`, `sig.figure-kit-meta/1`; fail-closed parsing |
| caps | `NODE_CAP = 60`, `SIDE_CAP = 20` per column, `EGO_CAP = 20` neighbours — in `graph_model.py`, enforced by builders |
| group, never prune | `group_by` on the spec collapses nodes into labelled group nodes (member ids + edges unioned in the twin); still-over-cap refuses — no ranking, no silent drop |
| access/relation distinction | line pattern classes from the lexicon (`configured`/`declared`/`observed`/`relation`); one compound `<path>` per edge class (K6 §6.3) |
| entity kind by shape | `kind:*` node marker classes — shape only, never an epistemic channel |
| legends from the lexicon | `figures/legend.py` — only-present encodings, lexicon's `interimLegendLine` wording, lexicon-declared order, fail-closed binding |
| table twins | `table_columns`/`table_rows` on every result metadata — stable columns, links, dates, currency, `sources`/`claim_ids`; never `data-*` |
| charts | `figures/chart.py` — bar / strip / stacked-bar / timeline; same-day strip events stack lanes; other kinds + malformed events refuse named |
| wide + narrow | `StaticFigureResult.svg` + `svg_narrow` (720/360 px); narrow truncates visible labels, full text in `<title>` |
| print rules | `@media print` — `.sig-fig*` `break-inside: avoid`, greyscale-safe; hatches, dashes and `≠` preserved |
| accessibility | `role="img"`, `<title>`, `<desc>` (every node/edge state), `aria-labelledby`; root-relative `<a href="/…">` links only |
| CLI | `sig-exports figure network|ego|chart` + `--out-narrow`; `map|locator|sprite` unchanged; refusals exit 4 |
| K5 'chart component' absorption | `chart.py` is DSRC-02's chart component — the audited surface is the closed four-kind vocabulary (ADR-226, Consequences) |
| ADR | `docs/adr/ADR-226-*.md` + registrations (appF, ADR_TRIGGERS, BL-086, adr index, spec rebuild) |

## Deviations (recorded, not smoothed)

- **Layout implemented in-repo instead of vendoring a BSD package.**
  The contract says "a BSD-licensed overview-layout wrapper" without
  naming a package. The two needed placements are closed-form (no
  iterative solver), so the strictest reading of the licence pin is
  zero third-party dependency — recorded as ADR-226 §1 with the
  wrapper boundary kept so a BSD package can slot in later if K2
  §6.3's real overview layout lands.
- **Node toolchain mismatch locally:** `web/package.json` requires
  Node `>=24 <25`; local is `v25.2.1`. `npm --prefix web run check`
  ran fully green regardless; the CI-pinned Node 24 run is
  authoritative — recorded, never hidden.
- **Impl-commit projection fix-forward:** the impl commit's
  projection manifest digested the still-uncommitted run ledger, so
  the docs job's `current_projection verify` failed (run 40836786401,
  docs leg) — repaired forward in `2d09d76b` (r11/** never force-push):
  regen with the pending closeout docs out of tree, verify
  1139/1139 input digests fresh.
